long_biography.plain_text:
Aermacchi's military trainers placed Fabrizio Foresio at the centre of Italy's aerospace industry for more than two decades. A Bocconi economics graduate, he directed a family-controlled manufacturer whose work included the MB-339 trainer and the AMX programme. His remit encompassed production planning, export agreements and long-term programme financing.

At Logic, Foresio moved from complete aircraft to electronic and electromechanical systems. The family-backed group invested in products, laboratories, production processes and acquisitions, expanding across three Italian sites. When Global Aerospace Technologies acquired the business, Foresio retained an investment through the family holding and joined the new parent's board.
